svg.title: All six shares have risen since 2000, the relative rise being largest for sanitation
svg.desc: Table: All six shares have risen since 2000, the relative rise being largest for sanitation: Share: Access to electricity: 91.6%, Clean fuels for cooking: 74.5%, Safely managed drinking water: 72.0%, Safely managed sanitation: 57.8%, Urban population: 57.3%, Secondary gross enrolment: 77.2%; Change: Access to electricity: 17.1%, Clean fuels for cooking: 56.0%, Safely managed drinking water: 17.5%, Safely managed sanitation: 84.7%, Urban population: 22.4%, Secondary gross enrolment: 29.9%.
